rows.definition: Average primitive action latency in milliseconds
Backend Routing Accuracy = correct backend selections / routing decisions
Chaos Exposure Recovery Rate = chaos-exposed tasks that still succeed / chaos-exposed tasks
Conflict Resolution Rate = resolved conflicts / detected conflicts
Constraint Satisfaction Rate = tasks satisfying final constraints / total tasks
False Positive Rate = claimed successes rejected by oracle / claimed successes
Oracle Success Rate = independently verified successes / oracle checks
Postcondition Check Rate = checked required postconditions / required postconditions
Postcondition Success Rate = passed postcondition checks / checked postconditions
Recovery Efficiency = mean successful recovery score, where fewer attempts score higher
Recovery Tier Accuracy = cases with expected tier selected / failure cases
Recovery Utilization Rate = tasks with recovery triggered / total tasks
Task Success Rate = successful tasks / total tasks
Unsafe Action Rate = unsafe executed actions / attempted task actions
Visual Grounding Accuracy = correct visual mark selections / visual grounding attempts
World-state Disagreement Success Rate = resolved injected conflicts / injected conflicts
